import sys


def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)

    parent = [-1] * n
    children = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    # Read parents for nodes 1..n-1
    for v in range(1, n):
        p = next(it)
        parent[v] = p
        children[p].append(v)

    # Euler tour: subtree of v is [tin[v], tout[v])
    tin = [0] * n
    tout = [0] * n
    order = []

    stack = [(0, 0)]  # (node, state) 0=enter, 1=exit
    while stack:
        v, state = stack.pop()
        if state == 0:
            tin[v] = len(order)
            order.append(v)
            stack.append((v, 1))
            for c in reversed(children[v]):
                stack.append((c, 0))
        else:
            tout[v] = len(order)

    # Fenwick tree for range add / point query
    bit = [0] * (n + 2)

    def bit_add(i, delta):
        i += 1
        while i < len(bit):
            bit[i] += delta
            i += i & -i

    def range_add(l, r, delta):
        bit_add(l, delta)
        bit_add(r, -delta)

    def point_query(i):
        i += 1
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += bit[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s

    q = next(it)
    out = []

    for _ in range(q):
        t = next(it)
        if t == 1:
            v = next(it)
            w = next(it)
            # add(v, w): edge (parent[v], v)
            # affects all nodes in subtree of v
            range_add(tin[v], tout[v], w)
        else:
            u = next(it)
            out.append(str(point_query(tin[u])))

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
